day_local: Khamiista Toddobaadka Labaatan iyo Shanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Masiixow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiyow, qarni kasta waxaad noo ahayd magangal.
homily:
Waxaa jira sawir yar oo maanta maskaxdayda ku soo dhacaya, sawir ka duwan kuwii aan hore u soo qaadannay. Waxaan arkaa diyaarad yar oo ay ku qoran tahay 'Con Chim Airlines' oo si tartiib ah ugu dul heehaabaysa daruuraha. Waxaan arkaa Ben oo si taxaddar leh u dhisaya, isagoo indhihiisu ay ka buuxaan iftiin iyo qorshayaal mustaqbal. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu wax walba u arko sida hawl-qabad weyn, laakiin wuxuu ahaa mid si qoto dheer ugu tiirsan xigmadda Ilaah. Waxaan maanta ka fikirayaa Ben, oo aan xusuusanayo sida uu u jeclaa inuu wax walba u xisaabiyo, sida uu ugu raaxaysan jiray koodhka kumbuyuutarka iyo qaab-dhismeedka diyaaradaha. Ben wuxuu lahaa maskax aad u fiiqan, laakiin wuxuu lahaa qalbi ka sii weyn.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, oo ka yimid Kitaabka Qohaleed, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Waanida waaniddeeda, wax walba waa waanid.' Qoraagu wuxuu ka hadlayaa wareegga nolosha—qorraxda oo soo baxda oo dhacda, webiga oo u qulqula badda, iyo jiilalka oo is-beddelaya. Waxay u muuqan kartaa mid murugo leh, laakiin dhab ahaantii, waxay inoo sheegaysaa in dunidan aysan ahayn meesha ugu dambaysa. Ben wuxuu fahmay in nolosha ay tahay hanti yar oo la inoo dhiibay si aan ugu adeegno kuwa kale. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay in waxa adduunkan lagu cabbiro—lacag, guul, iyo xitaa caafimaad—aysan ahayn waxa dhabta ah ee qofka ka dhiga qof weyn.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa Herod oo la yaabban cidda uu yahay Ciise. 'John baan madaxa ka gooyay. Kumaa markaas kan aan waxyaalahan ka maqlayo?' Herod wuxuu raadinayay jawaabo, laakiin wuxuu raadinayay xagga awoodda iyo cabsida. Wuxuu rabay inuu arko waxa dhacaya, laakiin qalbigiisu ma furnayn. In badan oo naga mid ah ayaa maanta la mid ah Herod. Waxaan is-weydiinnaa: 'Maxaa dhacay? Maxaa nolosha noo beddelay?' Waxaan raadinnaa jawaabo xagga xisaabta iyo sababaha. Laakiin Ciise ma aha mid aan ku xallin karno xisaab.

Saddex bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale. Waxaan ogahay in gurigiina uu leeyahay aamusnaan aan la sharxi karin. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii Alan, xanaanadii Thao—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil si xor ah u bixiyay jacaylkiisa. Xusuuso markuu ahaa 15 sano jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl aan sugin mahadcelin, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa. Ben wuxuu baray qoyskiisa in jacaylku aanu ahayn waxa aad haysato, laakiin waa waxa aad diyaar u tahay inaad bixiso.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay. Waxaan ogahay in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso. Sida uu kuugu sheegay riyadaada, halkaas oo aad ku wada raacdeen 'roller coaster', xidhiidhka idinka dhexeeya wuu sii socdaa. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo.

Waxaan rabaa inaan idinku dhiirrigeliyo inaad u oggolaataan in naxariista Ilaah ay bogsiiso qalbiyadiinna. Ha isku dayin inaad xalliso xanuunkaaga adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabtaada. Ha isku dayin inaad fahanto sababta uu Ben u baxay. Kaliya u dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. U oggolow inuu kula fadhiisto, kula cuno, oo kula qaybsado xanuunkaaga. Ciise ma aha mid iska fogeeya kuwa murugaysan; wuxuu u yimid inuu la fadhiisto. Wuxuu rabaa inuu noqdo dhakhtarkaaga maanta.

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon, wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.'

Ha iloobin in jacaylka Ben uu weli ku nool yahay adduunkan. Sida ceelka biyaha ee Cà Mau, ee uu magaciisa ku qoran yahay, jacaylkiisu wuxuu u socdaa dadka harraadsan, isagoo u keenaya nolol iyo rajo. Sidaas oo kale, qalbiyadiinna ha u furnaadaan rajo cusub. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.

petitions.petition_call: Waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa inuu Ben iyo dhammaan kuwa dhintay u furo albaabbada Jannada, halkaas oo ay ku nasan doonaan iftiinka Masiixa.
Waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa inuu qalbi qaboojiyo dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan Alan, Thao, iyo Ryan, si uu u siiyo rajo iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan noloshooda.

spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeeyey inaad ku jirto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, maadaama aanan maanta kugu qaadan karin wadaagga, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan. Waxaan isku duubayaa naftayda adiga, ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbiga ha inoo barakeeyo, ha inoo ilaaliyo xumaan walba, oo ha inoo horseedo nolosha weligeed ah. Aamiin.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Waanidda waaniddeeda, ayuu leeyahay Qohaleed, waanidda waaniddeeda! Wax walba waa waanid! Maxay faa'iido u leedahay dadka shaqada oo dhan oo uu ku daalo qorraxda hoosteeda? Jiil baa dhaafa, mid kalena waa yimaadaa, laakiin dunidu weligeed way sii jirtaa. Qorraxdu way soo baxdaa, wayna dhacdaa; ka dibna waxay ku degdegtaa meeshii ay ka soo bixi lahayd. Dabayshu waxay u dhacdaa koonfur, ka dibna woqooyi; dabayshu mar walba way wareegtaa, waxayna ku noqotaa wareeggii hore. Webiyada oo dhammi waxay u qulqulaan badda, haddana badda weligeed ma buuxsanto. Meeshii ay u socdeen, webiyadu way sii socdaan. Hadal oo dhammi waa daal; ma jiro wax qof sheegi karo. Isha laguma qanciyo aragga, dhegtana laguma qanciyo maqalka. Wixii jiray, waa kan jiri doona; wixii la qabtay, waa kan la qaban doonaa. Ma jiro wax cusub oo qorraxda hoosteeda ah. Xataa waxa aynu nidhaahno, 'Eeg, kani waa wax cusub!' wuxuu horay u jiray qarniyadii inaga horreeyay. Ma jiro xusuus dadkii hore; mana jiri doono xusuus kuwa iman doona dadkii ka dambeeyay.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Rabbiyow, qarni kasta waxaad noo ahayd magangal. Waxaad dadka u celisaa si ciid ah, adigoo leh, 'Ku noqda, carruurta dadka.' Kun sano oo indhahaaga ah waa sidii shalay oo kale, markii ay dhaaftay, ama sidii saacad habeenkii ah. R. Rabbiyow, qarni kasta waxaad noo ahayd magangal. Waxaad ku dhammaystaa hurdada; subaxdii waxay la mid yihiin cawska is-beddelaya, kaas oo waaberigii soo baxa, laakiin fiidkii engega oo baaba'a. R. Rabbiyow, qarni kasta waxaad noo ahayd magangal. Na bar sida aynu maalmaheenna u tirinno, si aynu u helno xigmad qalbi. Ku soo noqo, Rabbiyow! Ilaa goormaad sii wadi doontaa? U naxariiso addoommadaada! R. Rabbiyow, qarni kasta waxaad noo ahayd magangal. Subaxdii nagu buuxi naxariistaada, si aynu ugu qaylino farxad iyo raynrayn maalmaheenna oo dhan. Shaqada gacmahayaga noo barakee! Shaqada gacmahayaga noo barakee! R. Rabbiyow, qarni kasta waxaad noo ahayd magangal.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Herod oo ahaa taliyihii gobolka ayaa maqlay wax walba oo dhacayay, wuxuuna aad ula yaabay sababtoo ah qaar baa leh, 'Yooxanaa waa laga soo sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay'; qaar kalena waxay leeyihiin, 'Ilyaas baa ka soo muuqday'; qaar kalena, 'Mid ka mid ah nebiyadii hore ayaa sara kacay.' Laakiin Herod wuxuu yidhi, 'Yooxanaa anigaa madaxa ka gooyay. Kumaa markaas kan aan waxyaalahan ka maqlayo?' Wuxuuna sii waday isku dayga uu ku doonayo inuu arko.

day: Thursday of the Twenty-fifth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
